ideas.title: Narrow the online switch radius
ideas.hypothesis: Fewer objects switched online means less per-frame AI, animation and physics work, which is the binding constraint on this CPU-bound build.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. Alife optimization\gamedata\configs\alife.ltx [alife]: switch_distance 450 -> 300 and auto_switch_distance_normal 450 -> 300
ideas.measure: fps_1pct_low at the Rostok/Bar scene; guard frametime_p99_ms
ideas.notes: Highest-leverage single A-Life knob. Watch for NPC pop-in at the radius edge and for distant scripted events stalling.

ideas.title: Cap the A-Life per-frame time budget
ideas.hypothesis: A 4320 us A-Life slice inside a 16.7 ms frame is a visible stall; capping it converts long frames into marginally slower simulation.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. Alife optimization\gamedata\configs\alife.ltx [alife]: process_time 4320 -> 1500 (microseconds)
ideas.notes: A-Life catches up across subsequent frames, so simulation fidelity should be nearly unchanged.

ideas.title: Retune the A-Life scheduler cadence
ideas.hypothesis: Smaller, more frequent update batches spread the same total work across more frames and flatten the frame-time tail.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. Alife optimization\gamedata\configs\alife.ltx [alife]: schedule_min 170 -> 60, schedule_max 470 -> 160, objects_per_update 3 -> 2
ideas.notes: Three coupled values, deliberately tested together as one cadence policy. Bisect in generation 2 if it pays.

ideas.title: Drop the three heaviest per-frame Lua HUD mods
ideas.hypothesis: Roughly 40 actor_on_update hooks and 440 KB of Lua across three cosmetic mods is a measurable per-frame tax.
ideas.change: GAMMA\profiles\G.A.M.M.A\modlist.txt: flip + to - on '452- Interaction Dot Marks - Catspaw' (line 597), '330- Personal Adjustable Waypoint - Catspaw' (line 239), '350- Ledge Grabbing - Demonized' (line 488)
ideas.notes: Measures the Lua callback tax rather than proposing a permanent config. Real feature loss; bisect the three in generation 2 if the combined result pays.

ideas.title: A/B the vendor's alternative A-Life profile
ideas.hypothesis: The shipped 'Turn this on if you stutter' profile trades large infrequent A-Life batches for tiny constant ones; it may suit this CPU better than the default profile.
ideas.change: GAMMA\profiles\G.A.M.M.A\modlist.txt: enable 'Turn this on if you stutter' (line 196). It sits above 'G.A.M.M.A. Alife optimization' (line 315) so it wins the alife.ltx conflict. Net effect: schedule_min/max 170/470 -> 1/1, process_time 4320 -> 900, objects_per_update 3 -> 20, update_monster_factor 0.3 -> 0.1, switch_distance 450 -> 1500, auto_switch true -> false
ideas.notes: Opposite direction to I-001 on switch_distance, so the two ideas are a genuine fork in the beam. The 1500 m radius may bring far more NPCs online than is wise.

ideas.title: Enable the 12 GB prefetcher
ideas.hypothesis: With 31.7 GB installed, aggressive asset prefetch should cut load time and streaming hitches at no memory risk.
ideas.change: GAMMA\profiles\G.A.M.M.A\modlist.txt: enable "Meatchunk's prefetcher for G.A.M.M.A (needs 12Gb of Free RAM)" (line 145)
ideas.measure: load_time_s primarily; frametime_p99_ms for streaming hitches; guard ram_peak_mb against 28 GB
ideas.notes: Both prefetcher variants currently disabled. Do not enable both.

ideas.title: Halve dynamic anomaly density
ideas.hypothesis: Each live dynamic anomaly carries particles, a zone object and update cost, and Dynamic Anomalies Overhaul registers 12 actor_on_update hooks.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: drx_da/anomaly_amount_modifier 0.4 -> 0.2 and drx_da/anomaly_zone_spawn_chance 0.4 -> 0.2
ideas.measure: fps_avg and fps_1pct_low in open terrain, not the Bar interior
ideas.notes: Changes the artefact economy over a long playthrough; acceptable for benchmarking.

ideas.title: Halve the offline monster update rate
ideas.hypothesis: Offline mutant simulation is pure CPU work with no visual output, so halving its rate is close to free.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. Alife optimization\gamedata\configs\alife.ltx [alife]: update_monster_factor 0.3 -> 0.15
ideas.notes: Mutant migration across the map slows; a fidelity trade rather than a break.

ideas.title: Shorten the post-load switch ramp
ideas.hypothesis: auto_switch_distance_start brings a 1250 m sphere online for the first seconds after a load, which is the worst hitch in the session.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. Alife optimization\gamedata\configs\alife.ltx [alife]: auto_switch_distance_start 1250 -> 700
ideas.measure: load_time_s and fps_1pct_low restricted to the first 30 s after load
ideas.notes: Requires the load-time scene, not the steady-state walk scene.

ideas.title: Frame limiter for pacing
ideas.hypothesis: A hard cap below the GPU's capability removes frame-time variance on a heavily under-loaded 5080 and typically lifts 1% lows.
ideas.change: Anomaly\appdata\user.ltx: r__framelimit 0 -> 141 (rs_v_sync already off)
ideas.measure: frametime_p99_ms primarily; fps_avg will fall by design and must not be treated as a regression
ideas.notes: fps_avg dropping here is expected and is not a prune condition.

ideas.title: Cut screen-space indirect lighting quality
ideas.hypothesis: 32 samples is the expensive end of the ssfx indirect lighting pass; halving it should cost little visually.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: ssfx_module/il/quality_mcm 32 -> 16
ideas.notes: Classic r2_gi and r2_ssao are off; the actual ambient-light cost lives in this ssfx block.

ideas.title: Shrink the third shadow cascade
ideas.hypothesis: The far cascade drives CPU-side draw submission for distant geometry, which matters more on this box than its pixel cost.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: ssfx_module/shw_cascades/size_3_mcm 160 -> 110
ideas.measure: fps_1pct_low in the open Rostok yard
ideas.notes: Cascades 1 and 2 stay at 20 and 60 so near-field shadow quality is untouched.

ideas.title: Reduce the detail (grass) radius
ideas.hypothesis: Grass instancing is a known X-Ray CPU cost and GAMMA layers per-frame grass interaction on top of it.
ideas.change: Anomaly\appdata\user.ltx: r__detail_radius 110 -> 70
ideas.measure: fps_avg and fps_1pct_low in the open Rostok yard
ideas.notes: r__detail_density is already low at 0.25, so radius is the remaining lever.

ideas.title: Trim grass interaction entities
ideas.hypothesis: Every tracked entity costs per-frame grass displacement work, and a 2000 m tracking distance is far beyond what is visible.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: ssfx_module/inter_grass/max_entities_mcm 8 -> 4 and ssfx_module/inter_grass/max_distance_mcm 2000 -> 800
ideas.measure: fps_1pct_low in the open Rostok yard
ideas.notes: Pairs naturally with I-013 as a generation 2 combination.

ideas.title: Lower the sun shadow map resolution
ideas.hypothesis: A smaller sun shadow map cuts both fill and the cost of the shadow pass, though the margin on a 5080 at 1080p should be small.
ideas.change: Anomaly\commandline.txt: -smap2048 -> -smap1536
ideas.notes: Single-token change; cheap data point that also proves commandline.txt is being read.

ideas.title: Disable terrain parallax occlusion mapping
ideas.hypothesis: Terrain POM at quality 12 over a 20 m range is a per-pixel raymarch on every ground surface in view.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: ssfx_module/terrain/pom_quality_mcm 12 -> 0
ideas.notes: Ground texture goes flat at close range.

ideas.title: Throttle the blood pool system
ideas.hypothesis: 400 tracked blood pool updates at 0.2 s intervals is continuous Lua and decal work after any firefight.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: blood_pool/num_of_updates 400 -> 100 and blood_pool/update_freq 0.2 -> 0.5
ideas.measure: frametime_p99_ms measured after a staged firefight, not on the clean walk route
ideas.notes: Needs a combat-inclusive variant of the test scene to show anything.

ideas.title: Fewer dynamic cover rays
ideas.hypothesis: Cover raycasts are synchronous CPU work per NPC and scale with the number of NPCs in combat.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: dynamic_cover/rays_per_update 5 -> 2
ideas.notes: NPC cover-seeking gets visibly worse; a real gameplay cost, not just fidelity.

ideas.title: Widen the A-Life exclusion distance
ideas.hypothesis: Keeping spawns further from the actor reduces sudden online churn inside the player's immediate bubble.
ideas.change: Anomaly\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx [options]: alife/general/excl_dist 75 -> 150
ideas.notes: Confirm the engine-side semantics of this key before trusting any result from it.

ideas.title: Raise the skeleton update interval
ideas.hypothesis: Halving skinned-mesh update frequency cuts animation CPU cost in crowded hubs where many NPCs are visible at once.
ideas.change: Anomaly\appdata\user.ltx: rs_skeleton_update 32 -> 64
ideas.measure: fps_1pct_low inside the Bar with many NPCs in view
ideas.notes: Animation judder is the failure mode; check visually as well as numerically.

ideas.title: Cut subsurface scattering quality
ideas.hypothesis: 12 directional SSS samples on all foliage is a meaningful pixel cost for a subtle effect.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: ssfx_module/sss/quality_dir_mcm 12 -> 8
ideas.notes: GAMMA's foliage look depends on this; expect visual pushback before performance gain.

ideas.title: Reduce volumetric shadow quality
ideas.hypothesis: Volumetric shadow raymarching at quality 4 is per-pixel work that only shows in sunshafts.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: ssfx_module/shadows/volumetric_quality_mcm 4 -> 2
ideas.measure: fps_avg in a sunshaft-heavy outdoor segment at a pinned time of day
ideas.notes: Time of day must be pinned or the effect is not in frame at all.

ideas.title: Sunshaft quality step-down
ideas.hypothesis: Volumetric sunshafts at high quality are the most expensive legacy r2 post-process still enabled.
ideas.change: Anomaly\appdata\user.ltx: r2_sunshafts_quality st_opt_high -> st_opt_medium
ideas.measure: fps_avg outdoors at a pinned time of day
ideas.notes: r2_sunshafts_mode is volumetric; consider a mode change as a generation 2 child if this pays.

ideas.title: Disable dynamic wet surfaces
ideas.hypothesis: Dynamic wet surfaces render an extra 1024 shadow-map-like pass whenever it rains.
ideas.change: Anomaly\appdata\user.ltx: r3_dynamic_wet_surfaces on -> off
ideas.measure: fps_avg under a rain-pinned variant of the test scene
ideas.notes: Pays nothing in clear weather, so it needs its own rain scene.

ideas.title: Cap the rain drop count
ideas.hypothesis: 2500 simulated drops is a large per-frame particle budget during rain.
ideas.change: GAMMA\mods\G.A.M.M.A. MCM values - Rename to keep your personal changes\gamedata\configs\axr_options.ltx: ssfx_module/ssfx_rain_module/ssfx_rain_main/max_drops_mcm 2500 -> 1200
ideas.notes: Shares the rain scene with I-024; run them back to back.

ideas.title: Confirm the AVX build actually wins
ideas.hypothesis: The GAMMA shortcut assumes AnomalyDX11AVX beats AnomalyDX11 on this CPU; that assumption has never been measured here.
ideas.change: Run Anomaly\bin\AnomalyDX11AVX.exe against Anomaly\bin\AnomalyDX11.exe with identical configs (MO2 customExecutables entries 2 and 3)
ideas.notes: A validation experiment, not a change. If AVX shows no edge, later engine ideas simplify.

ideas.title: Geometry LOD step-down
ideas.hypothesis: A lower geometry LOD factor submits fewer triangles, which is a CPU draw-submission win more than a GPU one.
ideas.change: Anomaly\appdata\user.ltx: r__geometry_lod 1.5 -> 1.1
ideas.measure: fps_1pct_low in the open Rostok yard
ideas.notes: Earlier LOD popping is the visible cost.

ideas.title: Sound target and cache tuning
ideas.hypothesis: GAMMA layers many audio mods and OpenAL Soft mixing competes for the same core budget as the A-Life scheduler.
ideas.change: Anomaly\appdata\user.ltx: snd_targets 256 -> 128 and snd_cache_size 256 -> 512
ideas.notes: snd_efx is already off. Two knobs in opposite directions, so bisect if the combined result is ambiguous.

ideas.title: Verify and neutralise ReShade
ideas.hypothesis: If a ReShade chain is injecting, removing it frees a full post-process pass; the evidence here suggests it may not be injecting at all.
ideas.change: First verify: no dxgi.dll exists in Anomaly\bin (only a stale dxgi.log), and the 'Reshade Disabler' mod carrying a stub bin/dxgi.dll is disabled (modlist line 5). Only if injection is confirmed, enable 'Reshade Disabler'.
ideas.notes: Verify-first idea. Likely a no-op on this install; kept in the beam so the question is closed with evidence.

ideas.title: Match the launcher's sound-prefetch flags
ideas.hypothesis: AnomalyLauncher.cfg requests NOSNDFIX and NOSNDPREFETCH, but the MO2 direct-exe shortcut bypasses the launcher entirely, so those flags never apply.
ideas.change: GAMMA\ModOrganizer.ini customExecutables entry 2: add the launcher-equivalent sound-prefetch arguments to 2\arguments (currently empty)
ideas.notes: AnomalyLauncher.cfg also records 2560x1067 while user.ltx has vid_mode 1920x1080; resolve that discrepancy before comparing across launch paths. Exact argument spelling must be confirmed against the launcher's behaviour, since a strings sweep of the exe did not surface them.
